facts.note: A Free edition comes with Microsoft cloud subscriptions; P1 and P2 are paid.
Languages come from the MSAL tables (.NET, Java, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, Android Java and Kotlin, iOS Swift); the MSAL overview page also lists a Go library in preview, not counted here.
Entra ID is in the commercial cloud's scope for ISO 27001 and the HIPAA BAA. The SOC 2 Type 2 page lists it only for the US government clouds, and the PCI DSS page doesn't name it.
